title: LocalDeck 1.1.0-test.1 is beschikbaar
notes: Publieke Windows-testversie met een eenvoudiger interface, complete projectlevenscyclus, betere herstelacties en een compactere volledig ingebouwde offline runtime.
notesEn: Public Windows test release with a simpler interface, complete project lifecycle, improved recovery actions, and a smaller fully bundled offline runtime.

history.title: Een completere en rustigere LocalDeck
history.titleEn: A more complete and streamlined LocalDeck
history.notes: Nieuwe dagelijkse bediening, herstel en releasecontrole vanuit één Windows-app.
history.notesEn: New daily controls, recovery, and release verification in one Windows app.
changes: Nieuw Updatecentrum met versiegeschiedenis en veilige acties.
Compactere offline runtime en responsieve interface.
changesEn: New Update Center with version history and safe actions.
Complete release verification and automatic update restore point.
Privacy-safe support bundles and safe uninstall.
Smaller offline runtime and responsive interface.

history.title: De eerste publieke Windows-release
history.notes: De complete offline basis voor lokale PHP-ontwikkeling op Windows.
history.notesEn: The complete offline foundation for local PHP development on Windows.
changes: Apache, PHP 8.2–8.5, MySQL, phpMyAdmin, Mailpit en Redis.
Projecten, databases, HTTPS, mail en poorten vanuit één dashboard.
changesEn: Fully bundled runtime without an account.
Apache, PHP 8.2–8.5, MySQL, phpMyAdmin, Mailpit, and Redis.
App mode and Windows service mode.
Projects, databases, HTTPS, mail, and ports from one dashboard.
